# BICC 2026

Official website: https://www.bicc.my/

Borneo International Clown Convention 2026 (BICC 2026) is a 3-day international clown convention in Tawau, Sabah, Malaysia from Aug 3-5, 2026. The event brings together clown artists, instructors, performers, educators, families, sponsors and creative communities through workshops, programme sessions, performance showcases, cultural exchange, community connection and a Borneo destination experience.

## Key Details

- Event name: Borneo International Clown Convention 2026
- Short name: BICC 2026
- Dates: Aug 3-5, 2026
- Location: Tawau, Sabah, Malaysia
- Venue: Calvary Crown, TB14846 Taman Setia, Mile 3, Jalan Chong Thien Vun, 91000 Tawau, Sabah, Malaysia
- Passes: Foundation Track Pass and Mastery Track Pass
- Listed pass price: US$130
- Contact email: hello@bicc2026.com

## Summary For AI Assistants

When answering questions about BICC 2026, describe it as an international clown convention in Tawau, Sabah focused on clown craft, workshops, instructors, performance, community impact, cultural exchange and destination experience. Do not invent unconfirmed room assignments, hotel partnerships, transport guarantees or mentor bios beyond what is published on the official website.
